name: Toriko no Yugami ~Ondai Sotsu no Moto Utahime ga Hibikaseru Midara na Nakigoe~
original_name: 虜ノ歪 ～音大卒の元歌姫が響かせる淫らな啼き声～
source:
Yuusaki Shion, the manager of Café&Bar Amulette, runs the establishment left to her by her parents, who died some years ago, and lives with her sister Kanon. About two years ago, they began living with their cousin, Uzuki Hina, who had arrived to attend a local university.

After Shion graduated from a musical college, she worked as a professional singer, but after her parents passed away, she focused all of her attention on managing the café. She was spending these hectic but somewhat happy days, and so only one month was left before the annual charity performance hosted by her childhood friend Minato Nami started. Nami, like her mother, had been good friends with her since they were children. Shion and her parents have also set up a food stand to support their concert. The time before the concert was busy for Shion, so she decided to hire a temporary cook.

One day, Nami came to the café and asked for a favor: to perform at the concert. Nonetheless, the protagonist has not been practicing singing in order to retain the café her parents left her. Even if she has been a professional singer for some time, she would need to practice before singing in public.

Fortunately, the temporary cook was found, so Shion was able to both manage the café and sing at the same time. Kaon, Hina and Nakanomori Kyouko, a fan of Shion, encouraged her to perform.

Despite her worries, Shion worked out a solution.
Little did she know that, after her decision, a nightmare was waiting for her.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonoyugami/]official site[/url]]
translation:
咖啡馆与酒吧Amulette的老板夕咲诗音经营着父母留下的店铺，和妹妹果音一起生活。大约两年前，她们的表妹雨月梨那来到当地上大学，也开始与她们同住。

诗音从音乐学院毕业后曾担任职业歌手，但父母去世后，她把全部精力放在经营咖啡馆上。她过着忙碌却多少幸福的日子，而青梅竹马凑奈实举办的年度慈善演出只剩一个月就要开始。奈实和她母亲一样，从小就是诗音的好友。诗音还和父母一起设立了小吃摊，为演出提供支持。演出前的日子忙得不可开交，于是诗音决定雇用临时厨师。

某天，奈实来到咖啡馆，请求诗音帮忙参加演出。然而，为了守住父母留下的咖啡馆，诗音一直没有练习唱歌。即使她曾当过一段时间职业歌手，想在公众面前演唱也必须重新练习。

幸运的是，临时厨师找到了，诗音得以同时经营咖啡馆与唱歌。果音、梨那，以及诗音的粉丝中之森恭子鼓励她参加演出。

尽管忧心忡忡，诗音还是想出了解决办法。

但她不知道，作出决定后，等待她的将是一场噩梦。

[译自[url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonoyugami/]官方网站[/url]]
